snippet.title: The Archivist – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Currently in pre-production at Archivist Games.

Step inside The Archivist’s home… but once you enter, there’s no way back.

In The Archivist,  every VHS tape pulls you deeper into unsettling worlds. Search for hidden tapes, survive their nightmarish stories, and uncover the secrets whispered by The Archivist.

Follow our official social media accounts:


Instagram: www.instagram.com/archivistgames/ 

X: https://x.com/ArchivistGames  

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3984300/The_Archivist/

Archivist Games Website: archivistgames.com
